text:
No option can be put forward yet: the model could not check the **annual salary spend ≤ £400k/year** limit, so that constraint was excluded from the comparison.

- The comparison is **fragile** and rests on six Olumi-supplied values, not user evidence. Delivery capacity is the most sensitive assumption; the model’s source for it is Olumi’s estimate.
- The goal was treated as “more platform delivery progress is better”; that direction was not stated by you.
- The salary cap is recorded but unscored because annual salary spend is modelled as a change, not a total spend figure in the same frame as £400k/year.

A current analysis needs a spend limit expressed in the model’s comparable terms before it can assess compliance.
